title: Computational functionalism is neutral between reductive and sui generis phenomenal properties

statements.text: Computational functionalism fits both the view that a state's being conscious is nothing more than its playing a role in a computation, and the view that being conscious is having sui generis phenomenal properties for which that role is sufficient.

sources.quote: the view that a state’s being conscious is a matter of its having sui generis phenomenal properties, for which its role in implementing a computation is sufficient
